# BitSet

A growable set of bits.

```rux
pub struct BitSet {
    // private fields
}
```

Move-only: it owns its words.

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>BitSet</code></h3>

```rux
pub func BitSet(allocator: Allocator) -> BitSet
```

An empty set that spans no bits and has allocated nothing.

| ----------- | ----------- | ---------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | where the storage comes from |

**Returns**: the set
